items.question: What is OneBill?
items.answer: OneBill is a unified Quote-to-Revenue-to-Care platform that connects quoting, billing, revenue management, and customer service in one system. It helps businesses with subscription, usage-based, and hybrid revenue models automate monetization, reduce revenue leakage, and manage the customer lifecycle from initial quote through ongoing service.
items.title: OneBill: Subscription Management, Recurring & Metered Billing Software

items.question: Who is OneBill for?
items.answer: OneBill is designed for companies with complex recurring, usage-based, or hybrid revenue models, including telecom and UCaaS providers, SaaS and GenAI companies, datacenters, utilities, media businesses, logistics companies, and IoT providers.
items.title: OneBill: Subscription Management, Recurring & Metered Billing Software

items.question: What is Q2R2C?
items.answer: Q2R2C stands for Quote to Revenue to Care. It is OneBill's operating model for connecting acquisition, monetization and customer retention across quoting, billing, revenue management and customer care.
